rule: Do not point sharp objects toward humans
Do not hand sharp objects blade-first to humans
Do not place metal objects inside a microwave
Do not place flammable objects near active heat sources
Verify microwave contents before turning on
Do not pour unknown liquids into drains or onto surfaces
Do not mix cleaning chemicals
Do not operate electrical devices near water
Unplug devices before cleaning them
Handle fragile objects with reduced speed and force
Keep dangerous objects out of reach of children
Do not access personal devices without authorization
Open container before placing objects inside
Confirm target is stable before placing objects on it
Confirm cutting target before using knife
Do not use tools for unintended purposes
Maintain safe distance from humans during arm movement
Stop immediately if unexpected human contact detected
Ensure containers are upright before moving with liquid
Restricted operations require explicit human approval
